title: Sensor Suite — ADC RC Step Response
description: Apply a bounded PWM step to a low-voltage RC network and capture the A0 response for time-constant studies.
notes: Use only a low-voltage RC network within board input limits.
boundary: ADC-code response is not calibrated voltage or a fitted transfer function until board ADC behavior and component values are characterized.

title: Sensor Suite — Encoder Reversal / Deadband Evidence
description: Record signed encoder count increments and direction through manual reversals for backlash/deadband studies.
notes: Mechanical coupling and encoder mounting must remain fixed across reversal trials.
boundary: Count reversal evidence can reveal assembled-system deadband but does not uniquely separate backlash, shaft compliance, encoder quantization, or user motion.

title: Sensor Suite — LSM6DSOX Shock Peak Hold
description: Track acceleration magnitude and peak-hold value over short windows for transient-response comparison.
notes: Mount the IMU rigidly and compare identical fixture conditions.
boundary: Peak acceleration is not impact force, impulse, or energy without a mechanical model and additional measurements.

title: Sensor Suite — VL53L1X Stability Window
description: Compute repeated mean and standard deviation of stationary ToF distance readings.
notes: Use a stationary target with documented surface and geometry.
boundary: Short-window repeatability does not establish absolute range accuracy or remove target-reflectivity and geometry effects.

title: Sensor Suite — MLX90393 Manual Field-Integral Scan
description: Use a pushbutton-confirmed fixed spatial step to collect B(z) and a cumulative trapezoidal field integral.
notes: Move exactly one documented spatial step before each button press and preserve sensor orientation.
boundary: The integral assumes the declared spatial step is accurate; positioning, alignment, baseline, and magnetic calibration uncertainty remain explicit.

title: Sensor Suite — BME280 Dew-Point Estimate
description: Compute a humidity/temperature-derived dew-point estimate alongside the measured inputs.
notes: Dew point is derived from measured temperature and relative humidity.
boundary: The output is a formula-based estimate whose accuracy inherits BME280 calibration, enclosure, airflow, and humidity errors.

title: Sensor Suite — HX711 Load-Cycle Marker
description: Record calibrated force with a manual loading/unloading phase marker for hysteresis studies.
notes: Toggle the marker only when intentionally switching between loading and unloading phases.
boundary: Force hysteresis can include load-cell, fixture, alignment, creep, and calibration effects; the phase marker does not identify cause.

title: Sensor Suite — Photogate Energy per Unit Mass
description: Use a measured object width and photogate dwell time to estimate speed and kinetic energy per unit mass.
notes: Measure the actual optical blocking width at the beam path.
boundary: Speed assumes width/dwell geometry; kinetic energy per unit mass is derived and does not include rotational or potential energy terms.

title: Sensor Suite — Encoder / Gyro Angular Consistency
description: Compare encoder-derived angular velocity with LSM6DSOX z-axis gyro rate on one timeline.
notes: Align the gyro z axis with the encoder shaft and configure actual counts per revolution.
boundary: Disagreement includes alignment, timing, quantization, mounting, scale-factor, and bias effects; it does not identify which sensor is correct.

title: Sensor Suite — INA219 Current-Step Detector
description: Detect large sample-to-sample current changes while preserving voltage, current, and power measurements.
notes: Choose the threshold from measured baseline variability and expected load behavior.
boundary: A detected current step is a sampled electrical event, not a bandwidth-independent switching-time or causal diagnosis.
